english_name: Ultimate Hell: Ai Ruo You Lan
english_description: Introduces itself in-game as 'Hell's Quagmire — Ai Ruo You Lan' (the archive's own title is 'Ultimate Hell: Ai Ruo You Lan'). Part of the ES II to XKX to 'Hell' branch of the engine family, and part of a six-way 'Hell'/Doing-lineage map family with this collection's hell, zjdy2008wzb, zjdywzb, zjdyzj, and zjmudhell — a byte-level, line-ending-normalized room-tree comparison found it 95% identical to zjdy2008wzb and 94% identical to its closest sister zjdyzj ('Fingertip MUD' edition, sharing the same 'Hell' engine core down to near-identical master-file content), with that same map only ~73-79% identical to zjdywzb/zjmudhell — one shared authored wuxia world reused across all six builds, not a handful of coincidentally similar titles. Unlike zjdyzj, this build keeps a plain telnet registration flow rather than a mobile-client protocol layer. Not the same game as zhongjidiyu, another archive in this collection that also happens to carry 'Ultimate Hell' in its name. Deep testing found and fixed two independent bugs that both masked themselves as 'every command is broken' on a fresh connection: a pre-existing save-file quirk where the very first login after a restart rejected every command until a second login, and a separate query_save_file() empty-string crash in clone/user/login.lpc triggered on every connection (also found and fixed in sibling archives zhongjidiyu and zjdyzj).
